# Psalm 97 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** YHWH reigns, let-rejoice the-earth; let-be-glad islands many.

**2** Cloud and-thick-darkness around-him; righteousness and-justice foundation-of his-throne.

**3** Fire before-him goes, and-burns-around his-adversaries.

**4** Have-lit-up his-lightnings the-world; has-seen and-trembles the-earth.

**5** Mountains like-wax have-melted before YHWH, before the-Lord-of all the-earth.

**6** Have-declared the-heavens his-righteousness, and-have-seen all the-peoples his-glory.

**7** Are-ashamed all servants-of carved-images, those-boasting in-the-nothings; bow-down to-him all gods.

**8** Has-heard and-is-glad Zion, and-rejoice the-daughters-of Judah, because-of your-judgments O-YHWH.

**9** For you YHWH Most-High over all the-earth; very you-are-exalted above all gods.

**10** Lovers-of YHWH hate evil; he-guards the-souls-of his-faithful-ones; from-hand-of the-wicked he-delivers-them.

**11** Light is-sown for-the-righteous, and-for-the-upright-of heart gladness.

**12** Be-glad O-righteous in-YHWH, and-give-thanks to-memory-of his-holiness.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **97:2**: 'Cloud and-thick-darkness' (anan va'arafel) — theophany language from Sinai (Deut 4:11); God's presence is both revealed and concealed.

- **97:5**: 'Mountains like-wax' — the most solid features of creation become fluid before YHWH. Cosmic instability before divine stability.

— EMET
